# BrandLinker Spark

> BrandLinker Spark (https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/) sells and recommends travel gear for travellers from Bangladesh: universal travel adapters, power banks, luggage scales, locks and passport wallets. Some picks link to Amazon as an affiliate.

- [Best travel accessories](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/best-travel-accessories)
- [Universal travel adapter guide](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/guides/universal-travel-adapter-guide)
- [Carry-on packing list](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/guides/carry-on-packing-list)
- [What to pack for Dubai or the US from Bangladesh](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/guides/what-to-pack-dubai-or-us-from-bangladesh)
- [Shipping](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/shipping) · [Returns](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/returns) · [Affiliate disclosure](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/disclosure)

## BrandLinker family
This site is part of BrandLinker (https://brandlinkerbd.com/), founded by RS Lina in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Sister sites:
- [Cheap Ticket Finder](https://cheapticketfinder.site/): Cheap flight search for travellers in Bangladesh
- [BrandLinker Dubai](https://brandlinkerdubai.com/): Dubai off-plan property explained in Bangla and English
- [BrandLinker Studio](https://brandlinkerstudio.com/): Free online video editor in the browser
- [SheRides](https://sherides.online/): Women-only ride sharing in Bangladesh
